one_liner: Firecrawl has a broad hosted REST API (v2) with free self-serve API keys, OAuth 2.1 for apps, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer API keys (fc-...) are the main method. OAuth 2.1 'OAuth for apps' uses authorization_code with PKCE and refresh tokens (fco_ access tokens), and a dynamic registration endpoint exists. Clients are public with no secret. OAuth covers the full REST API on the user's chosen team, so it suits multi-user access.
access_notes: The free plan needs no card and gives 1,000 credits a month. Scrape, search and parse also work keyless, with per-IP limits.
blocker_notes: None. Free credits are limited but enough to build and test.

evidence.quote: An app where each user connects their own Firecrawl account | OAuth for apps
Firecrawl runs an OAuth 2.1 authorization server. Your app sends the user to Firecrawl, the user signs in and picks a team
Requests need an `Authorization` header with your API key, except on the keyless endpoints described below
New accounts start on the free plan. It costs nothing and does not need a card.
Sign up for a free API key to get 1,000 credits and higher rate limits at no cost
All requests use the following base URL: https://api.firecrawl.dev
Official MCP server - Search, scrape, and interact with the web from Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients
